sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims at cultivating students’ self-management abilities, helping them realize the importance of health and safety, form active learning habits. Besides, this module also enhances communicative abilities and teamwork spirits.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Help students understand self-management theories and learn self-management skills. 理解自我管理理论，学习自我管理技能。 B. Apply self-management skills to students’ study and life to analyse and solve practical problems. 将自我管理技巧应用于学生的现实学习与生活，从而进一步分析和解决实际问题。 C. Critically evaluate and reflect on the experiences on application of self-management skills to further deepen the understanding of self-management via the form of video presentation. 批判地评估和反思将自我管理技能应用于实践的经验，通过视频表达的方式进一步深化对自我管理的理解。
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Case Teaching; Independent analysis; group discussion; social practice
